jobs.detail: ONE HAND ON STABILITY BALL PUSH-UP, TWO phases, full body FRONT SIDE three-quarter camera head LEFT feet RIGHT. One round gray FULL SPHERE stability ball on floor at FAR/RIGHT shoulder side, no platform/bench. RIGHT hand palm on TOP/upper side of ball; LEFT hand palm flat on FLOOR at near side beneath LEFT shoulder. Both hands clearly visible in unequal height positions. Both feet wider than hips toes FLOOR behind, knees straight and core braced straight shoulder-hip-heel line. LEFT upper position floor-side LEFT elbow extended, ball-side RIGHT elbow flexed as needed for unequal hand height; palm contacts ball securely, no floating hand. RIGHT lower chest toward floor by flexing BOTH elbows while keeping torso/hips level, no rotation or sag, right palm remains ball and left floor at EXACT same locations, ball shape/size unchanged. Hands do NOT switch sides between phases; opposite-hand set performed later outside image. EXACTLY TWO arms/legs, whole sphere/person/hands/shoes in frame. Primary CHEST only smooth soft diffuse BLURRED red tint on opaque BLACK chest shirt; no anatomical fibers/radial lines/pectoral divisions in clothing. Fine grayscale exposed limb anatomy. Full opaque shirt/shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No text.
